bullet.name: bullet

cardTitle.name: card title

smallCardTitle.name: card title
smallCardTitle.fix: shorten the label, or move detail into its caption

cardCaption.name: card caption
cardCaption.fix: shorten the caption to a few words

smallCardCaption.name: card caption
smallCardCaption.fix: shorten the caption to a few words

messageLabel.name: message label
messageLabel.fix: shorten the label, or split the message in two

fieldName.name: field
fieldName.fix: shorten the field name or its type

tableCell.name: table cell
tableCell.fix: shorten the cell, or split the table

tableCode.name: table cell
tableCode.fix: shorten the cell, or split the table

flowAction.name: step
flowAction.fix: shorten the action, or use fewer steps so each has two lines

payload.name: payload
payload.fix: shorten the payload to the fields the step changes

flowCode.name: flow code
flowCode.fix: show fewer or shorter lines by narrowing `lines`; split a longer stretch across stages

flowWhere.name: step place
flowWhere.fix: nothing to change; the path is long, so the rail shows its end

stepLabel.name: step label
stepLabel.fix: shorten the step label to a few plain words

codePath.name: file path
codePath.fix: it is drawn smaller; nothing to change unless it runs into the line counts

hunkHeader.name: hunk header
hunkHeader.fix: it is drawn smaller; nothing to change

callout.name: callout
callout.fix: shorten the callout to the one point the code makes

code.name: code line
code.fix: set "view": "morph", which gives the code twice the width

testValue.name: promised value
testValue.fix: shorten the value to a word or a number, e.g. "3" or "1, 4, 16 s", or use fewer outcomes

testWas.name: old value
testWas.fix: shorten the old value in was

testGap.name: gap
testGap.fix: shorten the gap to what goes wrong

testNames.name: test names
testNames.fix: give the test a short `label` for the scene to draw, and keep `name` as its real title

testSubject.name: subject
testSubject.fix: shorten the subject, e.g. "listEvents in src/lib/pagination.ts"

findingClaim.name: review claim
findingClaim.fix: shorten the claim to what looks wrong; its evidence goes in review.md, not on screen

findingWhere.name: file and line
findingWhere.fix: the path is drawn smaller; nothing to change

readingCheck.name: reading check
readingCheck.fix: shorten the check to what to verify there

readingWhy.name: reading why
readingWhy.fix: shorten the why to one short line

readingFlag.name: reading flag
readingFlag.fix: shorten the finding's claim to what looks wrong

readingNote.name: explained in
readingNote.fix: shorten the chapter of the scene that explains it

chartValue.name: space beside the value on its left
chartValue.fix: the two values run into each other; round the values, shorten the unit, or use fewer labels or series

chartLabel.name: chart label
chartLabel.fix: shorten the label, or use fewer labels

annotation.name: annotation
annotation.fix: shorten the annotation to the one thing the point shows

legend.name: series name
legend.fix: shorten the series name, e.g. "before" and "after"

eventLabel.name: event label
eventLabel.fix: shorten the label, and move the rest to detail

spanLabel.name: span label
spanLabel.fix: shorten the span label, e.g. "backoff 4 s"

fileName.name: file name
fileName.fix: the name is drawn smaller; nothing to change

partCardDoes.name: what a part does
partCardDoes.fix: shorten the `does` line to one sentence of about 90 characters or fewer

partCardRisk.name: what to check in a part
partCardRisk.fix: the line is drawn smaller; shorten the `what` of the check item to fit two lines

partCardFile.name: file name
partCardFile.fix: the name is drawn smaller; nothing to change

fileNote.name: file note
fileNote.fix: shorten the note to a few words

layerLabel.name: layer label
layerLabel.fix: shorten the layer label, and move the rest to its caption

layerCaption.name: layer caption
layerCaption.fix: shorten the caption to a few words

tokenLabel.name: request token
tokenLabel.fix: shorten it to the request line or status, e.g. "POST /orders" or "429"

decision.name: decision
decision.fix: ask a shorter question, e.g. "Cache hit?", and put the detail in the narration

terminal.name: start or end
terminal.fix: shorten it to a few words, e.g. "Order placed"

sideTitle.name: side title
sideTitle.fix: shorten the side title, e.g. "Before" or "Redis"

compareLabel.name: row label
compareLabel.fix: shorten the row label to the aspect it compares, e.g. "On Redis outage"

compareCell.name: compare cell
compareCell.fix: shorten the cell, or split the comparison into two scenes

compareCode.name: compare snippet
compareCode.fix: shorten the snippet's longest line, or show the code in a code scene

compareCaption.name: compare snippet caption
compareCaption.fix: the caption is the hunk's file path and line numbers; it is drawn smaller, so shorten the path by reading a hunk of a file with a shorter one

regionLabel.name: region label
regionLabel.fix: shorten the label to a few words

arrayValue.name: cell value
arrayValue.fix: shorten the value, or show fewer cells so each is wider

pointerName.name: pointer name
pointerName.fix: shorten the pointer name, e.g. "lo" or "head"

memoryValue.name: value
memoryValue.fix: shorten the value, or say the rest in the narration
